entries.subject: DAMIT 16291: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: DAMIT model 16291, version 2023-10-03, pole (164°, -2°), period 12.08466 h, taken unchanged from the archive. Mirror solution 16292 recorded as an alternative.

entries.subject: Physical scale
entries.finding: 148 ± 8 km, volume-equivalent diameter DAMIT lists for this size-calibrated model. DAMIT marks the model as size-calibrated and lists an equivalent diameter of 148 ± 8 km with it; the model references describe the scaling.

entries.subject: Resolved surface imagery
entries.finding: No spacecraft or resolved ground-based image of this asteroid was found in the archives searched for this package.
entries.revisitWhen: A resolved image or a registered surface map of this asteroid is published.

entries.subject: PDS SBN catalogue values that disagree with the factsheet or are not shown
entries.finding: The display scale "74 km (size-calibrated model)" (damit-models) implies a diameter of 148 km, outside the added NEOWISE V2.0 neowise_mainbelt.csv record 457 (Masiero et al. 2014) diameter 167.381 ± 3.493 km (NEOWISE, NEATM). Both are shown; the display scale is not changed.
entries.revisitWhen: A newer release of the named catalogue, or a review that replaces the shown value.

entries.subject: Stereoskopia whole-disc color
entries.finding: Gaia Collaboration, Galluccio et al. (2023) published the mean of 19 Gaia epoch spectra of the unresolved disc: reflectance against the Sun in 16 bands from 374 to 1034 nm, 1 at 550 nm (0.954 at 462 nm, 1.018 at 638 nm). The shape is painted in that one color (#383836 in sRGB) through the shared disc-integrated-color method, scaled to the 3.9% geometric albedo JPL lists (± 0.6%), from NEOWISE (Masiero et al. 2014, ApJ 791, 121; PDS bundle neowise_diameters_albedos 2.0). It is one mean, not a map. Tinaut-Ruano et al. (2023), A&A 669, L14, found Gaia DR3 reflectances slightly too red at wavelengths shorter than 550 nm; the bands are used as published, without that paper's correction.
